entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Kestrel emits GOAWAY frame in response to WINDOW_UPDATE on closed stream #63726
  • Microsoft.Extensions.ObjectPool has unique assembly version convention relative to all the other Microsoft.Extensions and maintenance packages #63723
  • Perf improvement: https, json_middleware, mvc #63722
  • Microsoft.Extensions.FileProviders.Embedded Fails in .NET 10 with InvalidOperationException #63719
  • Can't publish Blazor WASM hosted when using 'MapStaticAssets' #63718
  • Blazor WASM doesn't use cache after upadate from net9.0 to net10.0 #63717
  • Perf issue: http.sys doesn't share ConnectionInfo class between requests of the same connection #63716
  • Analyzer support for non-public controller #63713

Closed

  • Perf regression: https #63714
  • Add support for file-based apps to dotnet user-secrets #63440
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Unexpected error: System.InvalidOperationException after Hot Reload #53492
  • Blazor WASM leaves detached nodes #61190
  • SecurityTokenInvalidIssuerException: IDX10204: Unable to validate issuer. validationParameters.ValidIssuer is null or whitespace AND validationParameters.ValidIssuers is null or empty. #54640
  • SetPasskeyAsync Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore.UserOnlyStore`7' from assembly 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore #63552

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Enable spectre mitigations for ANCM binaries #63728
    tell-mode
  • Don't build the composite runtime pack on Windows when we don't ship it #63724
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #63720

Merged

    area-networking, 11.0-preview1

    Servicing-approved, 10.0-rc2
  • [release/10.0] Update to Wix v5 #63711
    Servicing-approved, area-infrastructure, feature-installers, 10.0-rc2
  • [release/10.0] [Blazor] Clear RootTypeCache cache on HotReload #63653
    Servicing-approved, area-blazor, 10.0-rc2
  • [release/10.0] Fix ComponentStatePersistenceManager iteration to prevent AntiforgeryValidationException in Blazor WASM #63694
    Servicing-approved, 10.0-rc2
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #63625
    11.0-preview1
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63712
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0-rc2

Updated

    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • Support querying `TlsCipherSuite` on Http.Sys / IIS #63685
    feature-httpsys, area-networking

    Servicing-consider, area-blazor, feature-blazor-wasm, 9.0.x

    area-infrastructure, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun

    area-blazor, feature-validation

    analyzer, community-contribution
